intro.label: Pick your Audible marketplace and continue. On the next step, open Amazon to sign in; afterwards you land on a 'page not found' page (that is expected) whose URL you paste back into Music Assistant.

authenticate.title: Sign in to Audible
authenticate.description: Open the [Audible sign-in page]({0}) and log in. Afterwards you land on a 'page not found' page — that is expected. Copy the full address from your browser, paste it below, and select Finish.
